content_evidence_card.author: Living Language Atlas product seed
known_limits: No audio or pronunciation scoring is included in this reference build.
Completion records a deterministic rehearsal trace, not a CEFR or fluency claim.
All learner-facing Russian remains blocked from production publication pending qualified review.

stages.title: Read the sign
stages.can_do: I can spot a few Cyrillic shapes needed for this mission without treating them as Latin letters.
stages.evidence_boundary: This is a guided script check, not a claim of Cyrillic fluency.

tasks.title: Do not trust the shape
tasks.prompt: One letter in this mission looks familiar but makes a different sound.
tasks.translation: This letter is read with a v sound here, not like English B.
tasks.explanation: Cyrillic and Latin share some shapes, not a shared sound system. Treat the shape as a new signal.

tasks.title: Read one useful word
tasks.prompt: Which familiar café item can you recognize in КОФЕ?
tasks.retry_hint: Read the whole word. It is a café item, not an English spelling test.

tasks.title: Catch another false friend
tasks.prompt: Which Cyrillic letter is used for the r sound in a word such as ресторан?
tasks.retry_hint: The letter looks like Latin P, but its job in Russian is different.

stages.title: First contact
stages.can_do: I can greet formally and give my name in one supported exchange.
stages.evidence_boundary: This is guided phrase retrieval; it does not assess spontaneous conversation.

tasks.title: Start formally
tasks.prompt: You are meeting a café worker for the first time.
tasks.explanation: Use this formal greeting for the first encounter in this mission. The app is not teaching every greeting yet.

tasks.title: Recognize the question
tasks.prompt: Which line asks a person for their name using the formal register?
tasks.retry_hint: Look for the line whose job is asking a name, not giving one.

tasks.title: Give your name
tasks.prompt: Build the line that says: My name is Marco.
tasks.retry_hint: Start with the two-word frame, then add the supported name token.

stages.title: Make a café request
stages.can_do: I can request a menu and order one supported drink politely.
stages.evidence_boundary: The activity practices one bounded transaction, not free restaurant conversation.

tasks.title: Ask for the menu
tasks.prompt: You need to see what is available before choosing.
tasks.translation: May I have a menu, please?
tasks.explanation: Treat this as one polite request frame. The comma marks a pause in writing; you do not need a grammar lecture to use it here.

tasks.title: Order one drink
tasks.prompt: Build the line: A coffee for me, please.
tasks.retry_hint: Keep the polite marker between the request frame and the drink.

tasks.title: Ask the price
tasks.prompt: Which question asks how much the item costs?
tasks.retry_hint: Choose the question about cost, not the request for a menu.

stages.title: Repair the interaction
stages.can_do: I can ask for repetition or slower speech when I lose the thread.
stages.evidence_boundary: The app rehearses a chosen repair response; it does not judge listening ability or pronunciation.

tasks.title: Ask for one repeat
tasks.prompt: The other person answered, but you missed it.
tasks.explanation: Repair is part of communication, not a penalty. This formal request keeps the interaction open.

tasks.title: Name the problem clearly
tasks.prompt: Which line means: I do not understand?
tasks.retry_hint: Choose the line that says the problem plainly instead of asking a new question.

tasks.title: Request a slower reply
tasks.prompt: Build the line: More slowly, please.
tasks.retry_hint: Name the speed first, then make the request polite.

mission.title: First encounter at the café
mission.changed_detail: The demonstrated coffee order becomes tea, then the server speaks too quickly.
mission.evidence_boundary: This reference build records a deterministic rehearsal trace. It cannot issue a language level, pronunciation, or fluency judgement.

steps.title: Open the interaction
steps.prompt: The server looks up. Build a formal hello.
steps.retry_hint: Use the formal greeting from the first-contact step.

steps.title: Give one personal detail
steps.prompt: The server asks your name. Build: My name is Marco.
steps.retry_hint: Use the same supported frame; the mission asks you to retrieve it without a reveal.

steps.title: Handle one changed detail
steps.prompt: The menu is out of coffee. Order tea instead, politely.
steps.retry_hint: The request frame stays; only the drink changes from coffee to tea.

steps.title: Recover when the reply is too fast
steps.prompt: The server says the price too quickly. Which response keeps the interaction going?
steps.retry_hint: The problem is speed, so choose the repair that asks for a slower reply.

steps.title: Close politely
steps.prompt: You have your tea. Build a thank-you and goodbye.
steps.retry_hint: Thank the person before closing the encounter.
